def get_nearest_location(self, location: mod_geo.Location) ->Optional[
    NearestLocationData]:
    """ Returns (location, track_no, track_segment_no, track_point_no) for the
    nearest location on map """
    result: Optional[NearestLocationData] = None
    result_distance: Optional[float] = None
    for pt, tr, seg, pt_no in self.walk():
        dist = pt.distance_2d(location)
        if dist is not None:
            if result_distance is None or dist < result_distance:
                result_distance = dist
                result = NearestLocationData(pt, tr, seg, pt_no)
    return result
